content: ASP.NET Core 9/10 static files: with a FallbackPolicy, MapStaticAssets endpoints are subject to it; docs: app.MapStaticAssets().Add(b => b.Metadata.Add(new AllowAnonymousAttribute())). Same applies to any endpoint lacking auth metadata (e.g. MapFallbackToFile). MapStaticAssets uses a build manifest; files added after build are served by a runtime fallback that logs a warning (DisableStaticAssetNotFoundRuntimeFallback). Source learn.microsoft.com/aspnet/core/fundamentals/static-files.
